title: 写入 ADR-006: Official vs Custom Boundary
description: 创建 ADR-006，记录 Official Skill 和 Custom Skill 的物理隔离架构决策。Official = BaseDirectory.Resource (tauri resource, readonly)，Custom = BaseDirectory.AppData (user data, writable)。Custom 不可覆盖 Official，冲突时保留 Official + warning。source 由 Registry/Loader 自动填充，非 skill.json 字段。
action: 创建 docs/adr/006-official-vs-custom-boundary.md，使用 template.md 格式。Status: frozen baseline。Content: Context (双目录隔离需求)、Decision (Official=Resource readonly + Custom=AppData writable + 冲突保留 Official + source 注入语义)、Constraints (Custom 不可覆盖 Official; source 不可来自 skill.json)、Rejected Alternatives (Custom 覆盖 Official; boolean official 字段代替 source 联合类型; 单目录+前缀区分)、Consequences (✅ 物理隔离/冲突安全/调用方透明、⚠️ tauri 平台依赖)、Compliance (grep 验证 source 注入)、References (skillRegistry.ts:27-33/120-135; context.ts:32; tauri.conf.json resources+fs scope)、Cross-References (ADR-005)

criteria: docs/adr/006-official-vs-custom-boundary.md contains 'Custom 不可覆盖 Official' or contains '冲突保留 Official'
convergence.definition_of_done: ADR-006 写入完成，包含完整双目录隔离策略、冲突规则、source 语义，frozen baseline，引用 ADR-005

files.change: 创建完整 ADR-006，按 template.md 格式，frozen baseline status

implementation: 2. Context: 两棵 skills/ 目录需要物理隔离，Official 应天然只读不可被篡改

3. Decision: Official = BaseDirectory.Resource (tauri resources 只读), Custom = BaseDirectory.AppData (用户数据可写)。冲突规则: Registry 先扫 Official 再扫 Custom，冲突时 console.warn + continue。SkillMeta.source 联合类型 ('official'|'custom') 由 Registry/Loader 注入，skill.json 不可写此字段
4. Constraints: Custom 目录中同 id skill 不可覆盖 Official; source 字段禁止从 skill.json 解析; 调用方(chat/MentionPopup)无需感知 source 差异
5. Rejected Alternatives: Custom 覆盖 Official(安全漏洞); boolean official? 字段(不可扩展); 单目录+文件名前缀(混乱)
6. Consequences: ✅ 物理隔离 / 冲突安全 / 升级 Official 不破坏 Custom; ⚠️ 用户不知 Custom 被忽略(只有 warning log)
7. Compliance: grep 检查是否有代码从 skill.json 读取 source 字段; 审查 Registry constructor 是否使用两个 BaseDirectory

8. References: skillRegistry.ts:27-33 (双 BaseDirectory 构造器), skillRegistry.ts:120-135 (discoverSkills 冲突规则), context.ts:32 (SkillMeta.source 类型定义), skillLoader.ts:93 (Loader source:'custom'), tauri.conf.json (resources+fs scope)
9. Cross-References: ADR-005 (Registry 使用双 BaseDirectory 实现扫描)
